title: A set of crowdsourced depth cells: an area extract with its cells, or the description of a vector tileset

licence.description: SPDX identifier of the data licence, for example CC0-1.0.

edition.description: Increases whenever any cell in the set changes. A client rebuilds its index when the edition differs from the one it built from.

verdat.description: S-57 VERDAT code of the chart datum the depths are reduced to, for example 23 (LAT) or 3 (MSL). Cells with reduction none are not on it.

leafZoom.description: Zoom of the cells built from soundings; 18 is about 76 m at 60 degrees N.

shoalQuantile.description: Quantile of the reduced soundings that dShoal reports at the leaf zoom, for example 0.05.

sources.description: Upstream archives the soundings came from, for example the IHO DCDB.

cells.description: The cells of an area extract, every zoom from minZoom to leafZoom.

tiles.description: Mapbox Vector Tiles whose features in layer are the cell polygons, each carrying the csb-cell.json properties.
